recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（側散射 SS 對 CD3，活細胞閘門），非形態影像；低側散射、CD3 陽性的藍色族群佔活細胞 76.95%，代表明顯擴增的 T 細胞族群，灰色高側散射的是 CD3 陰性的顆粒球。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gated on [Living Cells]
Boxed region of low side scatter CD3-positive events annotated CD3+ : 76.95%
Dominant blue CD3-positive population with low side scatter, with red and magenta subsets inside the gate
Grey CD3-negative high side scatter events consistent with granulocytes, plus intermediate side scatter events consistent with monocytes
Green CD3-negative low side scatter lymphoid events (non-T lymphocytes)
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of viable cells displays CD3 versus side scatter. A large low side scatter, CD3-positive population comprises 76.95% of the annotated events, indicating a marked T-lymphocytosis relative to CD3-negative granulocytes (high side scatter), monocytes and non-T lymphocytes. A grey CD3-positive streak extending to higher side scatter likely represents a separate or artifactual population and is not further characterized here. An expanded mature T-cell population of this size supports the given diagnosis of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which requires further antigen profiling (CD4/CD8, CD7, TCL1) for classification.
